segments.text: Ok so this is the Headless Interrupts page for OpenAI Agents with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, it says the backend agent emits an interrupt, but no such backend is shown.
And it uses a ticketing agent that's never registered anywhere.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, registering the ticketing agent, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. I asked it to ship the ticket, it should show an approval, but the agent just replies, no approval shows up.
So basically, there's no ticketing agent and no backend that interrupts.
So yeah, kindly check this and fix it.
